text:
Wow that sounds really tricky... 😕 I really think this is something you need to have an open conversation about with your husband. If you avoid mentioning it for fear of hurting his feelings, you will be silently carrying everything on your own to keep the peace. You should not have to do that - it naturally causes resentment and can be really corrosive to a relationship, as well as your own happiness.  

The conversation doesn't have to be about him choosing between you and his mother (and try not to let him frame it that way). It is about what your marriage looks like as its own unit, healthy boundaries, and what feels healthy for both of you. Your feelings (and your red line about her not moving in) are *extremely* valid, and husband is the one who the most power to change this situation. Part of that conversation might be exploring together whether there are other ways to support his mum - other family members, friends, community - so that the responsibility does not fall entirely on the two of you.
